name: REFR: model27's reference effect for the reverb slot, a low-pass whose speed follows Size
description: The reverb slot's reference effect (notes/68, step F1), as REFD is the delay slot's: the mixer's call of the reverb goes to the builder's dispatcher (tools/machines/fxslot/), which calls REFR when the playing pattern chooses id 255 for the reverb slot, and the stock reverb otherwise. REFR is a one-pole low-pass per channel, not a reverb. Never offered to users.

uses.name: REF Reverb
uses.why: an effect of the reverb slot: called as the stock reverb 0x400579c4 is, (out, in, P + 432), when the device has chosen id 255

emulation.pattern: notes/68 §17: instructions per block of the process called alone after its reset (the reset counted apart), on the OS 1.13 in tools/emu/test_fxslot.py section 6 (mcengine.py's counter): noise of +-2^28 into both channels, Time 0 and Fdbk 96 for the delay, Size 64 and Tone 96 for the reverb (x 256), the first block, then the mean and maximum over 21 blocks after 32 more

unchanged: the stock reverb, whenever the device has not chosen REFR
